description: This file defines the class tlvApHeCapabilities, which models the capabilities of an Access Point's HE (High Efficiency) features in a Wi-Fi context. It includes data structures for flags, methods for managing supported MCS, and serialization functionalities.

classes.name: tlvApHeCapabilities
classes.description: Represents the HE capabilities of a Wi-Fi access point, including support flags, supported MCS, and serialization methods.
